attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Psychological Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 credits related to psychology presented or approved by APA, National Register of Health Service Psychologists, ASPPB or AMA; up to 20 from graduate courses (max 20), textbook chapters (max 5), peer-reviewed articles (max 5), new lectures/seminars (max 5), new course teaching/curriculum (max 5)
rules.new_licensee_rule: New licensees do not complete CE before licensure; CE is due after being licensed for 2 years (Board FAQ).
rules.carryover: Up to 10 credits may be carried over to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Do not send proofs unless requested; Board audits; keep proof 4 years after completion.
rules.notes: Of 40 credits: 4 in domestic violence, 1 on prescription opioid drugs (risks and signs of abuse, addiction, diversion), 1 via the Board's online jurisprudence review (N.J.A.C. 13:42-10.21(c)). CE due by June 30 of odd years. Board posted a revised Rule 10 for public comment (12/2025).
rules.rule_quote: Licensed psychologists are required to obtain 40 continuing education (ce) credits for each biennial (2-year) renewal period.
